paragraphs.text: Orim was one of the core members of the Weatherlight crew , performing numerous duties on the ship.

Born of the desert, Orim learned the ways of a healer, and traveled to New Argive to study at the Argivian University to train in the Samite arts. This is where she first met Hanna of Tolaria , and they quickly became friends. They joined the Weatherlight Crew at the same time, where Orim became the ship's chief healer, quartermaster, tailor, and interpreter. She played a key role in saving the crew in Mercadia , where she learned to use Cho-Arrim water magic. With Cho-Manno, she actively worked on rousing the peoples' hearts, leading to the Revolution on Mercadia . She also helped significantly during the Phyrexian Invasion when she found a cure for the Phyrexian plague. She survived the war and ultimately returned to Mercadia to be with her love, Cho-Manno .
Oriss was a woman who followed the Samite tradition founded in Mercadia by Orim; she was Orim's daughter.
